name: cogentstack
description: Reuse one signed-in CogentStack browser workspace across isolated ChatGPT Project contexts, restore portable Git-backed project knowledge, and execute approved project actions.

interface.shortDescription: One workspace tab, isolated contexts, portable knowledge.
interface.longDescription: CogentStack reuses an existing CogentStack workspace or home tab and its normal Chrome or Edge session, navigates that same tab to the hosted workspace when needed, hides the desktop sidebar, places a clean white backdrop behind the workspace, and presents the web document itself as a reversible page-only right panel in an equal-width 50/50 split. The launcher treats the invoking task's stable ChatGPT Project work-area context as authoritative, waits through brief accessibility rendering transitions, and uses the visible Project label as the live isolation signal. Each invocation belongs to exactly that ChatGPT Project: a different or unresolved visible Project suspends the split and can never make the running watcher switch contexts. Invoking CogentStack from another Project starts that Project's logical session while reusing the same physical tab. Without remembered state it inventories exact workspace and home titles without selecting tabs, activates at most one candidate, and verifies that candidate's CogentStack address. It never cycles through tabs whose titles merely contain CogentStack, never touches unrelated ChatGPT, Claude, installation, account, or legal tabs, and restores the original tab if verification fails. Concurrent launches are serialized before resolution so repeated invocations cannot race into extra workspace tabs. A passive 12-pixel white divider with matching two-pixel neutral-grey rules at the desktop and CogentStack edges, separated by eight pixels of white space, is owned by the reused browser so it stays above that browser's shadow without becoming globally topmost; it is shown only while the two-panel geometry and divider ownership are verified. The launcher verifies that both panels remain above the backdrop and restores the ordinary layout if either would be covered. Browser controls are positioned outside the work area without using monitor-wide F11; the companion header X returns that same tab to the CogentStack home page, restores the normal browser frame, maximizes that ordinary browser window, restores the desktop window, and removes the backdrop and divider. It reports login only when that selected page exposes its account control and never reads or copies cookies or credentials. Only when no exact workspace or home candidate exists does it open the exact hosted URL once as a normal tab in the registered browser. An isolated native Codex panel remains available only when explicitly requested and uses the account-bound installation credential without repeating legal confirmation. Natural-language briefs become explicitly approved projects through verified server-generated artifacts without refreshing away the approved setup, approved Deployment Packs can be prepared, and project-folder deletion runs only after exact hosted confirmation. Project Type Contracts, blueprints, compatibility rules, licence validation, and subscriber data remain on the protected CogentStack service.
